name: Keo cu do
summary: Kẹo cu đơ is the sweet at Chợ Đồng Hới, sold with bánh xèo, cháo canh, and bánh canh.
origin: Chợ Đồng Hới, with the crepe and the noodle bowls.
howToEat: Buy it with the market stalls, in the early morning or the afternoon, when most counters are selling.
where: Chợ Đồng Hới, on Mẹ Suốt.
seoTitle: Keo cu do at Dong Hoi Market
seoDescription: Kẹo cu đơ is the sweet at Chợ Đồng Hới, sold with the noodles and the crepe.
